title: Ultimate Divine Weapons
description: Wield the power of Heaven and Earth! This mod adds two ultimate mythological swords: the server-exclusive Houtu God Sword (forged via a unique obsidian ritual) and the Huangtian God Sword (features lightning strikes, execution, and aerial abilities).
body:
Ziyang's Divine Weapons: Huangtian & Houtu
🎯 Project Purpose
The goal of this project is to introduce breathtaking, god-tier weapons inspired by Chinese mythology into Minecraft. Moving beyond traditional weapon mods that merely inflate damage stats, we have designed server-exclusive uniqueness and complex combat mechanics (such as mark-based executions and AOE ascension attacks). Whether you are competing in a multiplayer server or battling in a single-player world, this mod delivers a truly epic and overwhelming combat experience.

✨ Core Features & Mechanics
This mod currently features two opposing yet complementary god-tier weapons, each coded with advanced and independent mechanics:

⛰️ The Houtu God Sword (Earth) — The Ultimate & Exclusive Artifact
A supreme weapon representing the immense power of the Earth, featuring a strict acquisition method and unparalleled prestige.

Server-Wide Uniqueness: Strictly monitored by server-side World Data. Whether in a single-player world or a 100-player server, only ONE Houtu God Sword can exist in the entire world at any given time, pushing the concept of "rarity" to the absolute limit.

Epic Forging Ritual: It cannot be crafted on a normal crafting table. Players must obtain the exclusive "Houtu God Core" and sacrifice it by right-clicking on a [Crying Obsidian] block to awaken the sword.

Celestial Anomaly & Global Broadcast: Upon a successful ritual, a visual lightning bolt will strike the altar (without destroying dropped items), and a server-wide broadcast will announce: "A celestial anomaly! Player [Name] has awakened the one and only [Houtu God Sword]!"

⚡ The Huangtian God Sword (Heaven) — The Wrath of Heaven
A weapon representing the furious power of the sky, offering hardcore and satisfying combo mechanics.

Passive [Mark of Heaven]: Every basic attack summons a real lightning bolt to strike the target and clears their vanilla invulnerability frames. It also applies a hidden NBT-based mark. Once the target reaches 9 stacks, it triggers a Divine Execution, instantly killing the target regardless of their remaining health.

Active [Divine Ascension]: Hold right-click to charge your power and defy gravity! The player will ascend into the sky, gaining [Resistance] and [Slow Falling]. Upon reaching the apex, the player will unleash a devastating 360-degree storm of 16 lightning projectiles to obliterate surrounding enemies.
